# Optional feature + test dependencies for the uv `default` CI variant.
# Installed on top of core ObsPy (`.`, i.e. install_requires); this is the
# pip/uv counterpart of .github/test_conda_env.yml. It mirrors setup.py's
# `all` extra (the flat union of every EXTRAS_REQUIRES entry) so the uv job
# exercises the same optional stack as the conda job, without reaching into
# the user-facing `.[all]` extra. Keep this in sync with test_conda_env.yml
# and EXTRAS_REQUIRES in setup.py.
#
# geo
geographiclib
# imaging
cartopy
# io.shapefile (pyshp!=3.0.0 for the tests: doctest workaround, see #3600)
pyshp!=3.0.0
# tests
packaging
pyproj
pytest
pytest-cov
